row.body: Tuesday at dusk: two workers from the pest-control test carried black specks. the garden browned before the checkpoint appeared.
row.title: Tuesday at dusk — black specks

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same black specks while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
